# Heading links

Each line says where its link should land in the compiled book (M17).

A note: [[1.2 Dueling]] lands on Dueling.

A heading in another note: [[1.2 Dueling#Zeal]] lands on the Zeal that
follows Dueling.

A heading in this note with spaces and brackets: [[#Grit and Moss (optional)]]
lands on Grit and Moss (optional).

The same, written by hand in lower case: [grit](#grit%20and%20moss%20(optional))
lands on Grit and Moss (optional).

A heading text that another note has too: [[#Zeal]] lands on Zeal under
Heading links, not under Dueling.

The second of two headings with the same text: [[#Part Two#Notes]] lands on
Notes under Part Two.

## Grit and Moss (optional)

Grit text.

## Zeal

Zeal of the heading links.

## Part One

### Notes

First notes.

## Part Two

### Notes

Second notes.
